config_changes: Isolation-only host port remapping to 127.0.0.1:19088 for Router and 127.0.0.1:19082 for Broker; Druid internal ports unchanged.
Strict retest harness set DRUID_XMS=1g and DRUID_XMX=1g to satisfy the >=1GiB validation threshold.
Validated nearest available official release image apache/druid:37.0.0 because source compose referenced apache/druid:38.0.0 and Docker Hub returned no manifest for that tag.

reachability.entry: POST /druid/v2/sql/ on Druid Router HTTP port 8888

trigger.request_shape: POST http://127.0.0.1:19088/druid/v2/sql/ with Content-Type text/plain and streamed Content-Length SQL body.
trigger.bandwidth_notes: Sequential local HTTP requests only; the 512MiB streamed body caused Router connection reset and target JVM exit.

peak.router_observed_rss: 1.736GiB after 256MiB request; 512MiB request reset connection before response

utilization_conditions.summary: 官方 Druid Docker quickstart 派生部署中，Router /druid/v2/sql/ 匿名可达；在 DRUID_XMS=1g / DRUID_XMX=1g 的严格补测下，单个 512MiB text/plain SQL body 触发 Router JVM `OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` 并退出。
limits_or_mitigations: Default quickstart did not reject the probed text/plain SQL body before Router heap OOM.
Reverse proxy, Jetty, or Druid-level request body limits below the failure threshold would block this exact trigger.
Authentication, authorization, per-client rate limits, or network isolation of Router reduce external reachability.
Different Druid versions or a fix that streams or caps raw SQL bodies may change exploitability.
not_affected_when: The Router /druid/v2/sql/ endpoint is not exposed to low-trust clients.
Requests with text/plain or form-urlencoded SQL bodies are capped below the memory-pressure threshold.
The deployment requires authenticated roles not available to the attacker.
A front proxy rejects large bodies before they reach the Druid JVM.

safety.heap_or_container_limit: Druid Router DRUID_XMS=1g and DRUID_XMX=1g; no Docker mem_limit set in the case compose

static_traceability.source: POST /druid/v2/sql/ with Content-Type text/plain or application/x-www-form-urlencoded; Router path also calls SqlQuery.from(HttpServletRequest,ObjectMapper).
static_traceability.sink: SqlQuery.from rawQueryExtractor uses IOUtils.toByteArray(request.getInputStream()) and constructs a String before trim/decode.
static_traceability.driver: HTTP request body byte volume; concurrent body submissions multiply live byte[]/String pressure.
missing_static_evidence: Actual Jetty max request body behavior for these content types under official default packaging.
Heap growth threshold and whether reverse proxy examples impose body-size limits.

notes: 2026-06-30 reinforcement fixed the probe size ladder and streamed request bodies so --max-size 536870912 actually sent a 512MiB request.
The 512MiB text/plain request caused RemoteDisconnected on the client and Router ExitCode=3 with `Terminating due to java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` in compose logs.
